flows:
Navigate to https://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_picker.asp#main then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
From the bookmarked main color-picker section, press Tab three times.
The first two stops are Previous and Next.
The third stop is the leftmost dark blue swatch in the top row.
Press Enter once on the swatch.
Verify the selected color now reads #003366.

summary:
After the consent dialog was accepted, keyboard focus was no longer at the color-picker starting point. The test continued with the planned Tab sequence without first confirming or restoring that starting position.
Update the automation to handle the consent dialog as a separate state: dismiss it, verify focus is at the intended color-picker starting point, then begin counting Tab presses. Do not treat unrelated analytics request failures as a color-picker failure.
one_liner: The run assumed that closing the consent dialog restored focus to the bookmarked color-picker section, but the next Tab began at Home.
reason: The consent dialog reset focus; first Tab now focuses Home rather than Previous.

verdict.root_cause: After the consent dialog was accepted, keyboard focus was no longer at the color-picker starting point. The test continued with the planned Tab sequence without first confirming or restoring that starting position.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the failed assertion by relying on a focus state that was invalidated when it dismissed the consent dialog. It used an allowed key and did not misuse a page control, but it failed to re-establish or verify focus at the bookmarked main section before counting Tab stops. There is no evidence that the color picker itself failed to select or display a color.
verdict.bug_title: Consent dismissal leaves keyboard focus outside the color-picker sequence
verdict.suggestion: Update the automation to handle the consent dialog as a separate state: dismiss it, verify focus is at the intended color-picker starting point, then begin counting Tab presses. Do not treat unrelated analytics request failures as a color-picker failure.
